## Goal

One or two sentences on the outcome that should be true when this is done.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] US1-AC1 — checkable outcome (`e2e`)
- [ ] US4-AC3 — include the awkward cases: empty, invalid, blocked, missing content (`e2e` / `manual`)

Every AC must name an id from `product-spec.md` and a proof. If it cannot be checked, it is not
ready.

## Out of scope

- Adjacent work that does not belong here
- A follow-up issue for anything worth keeping

## Constraints

- Files/directories in scope
- Libraries or patterns to use/avoid
- Content guardrails: certifications, contact details, history, product facts, official assets
- Proof: `make verify` plus any named manual check

## Human checkpoints

- [ ] Certification wording/documents
- [ ] Contact details
- [ ] About/company-history copy
- [ ] Product names, ingredients, sizes, prices or packaging
- [ ] Logo or approved photography

## Notes

Link the design reference, related issues, or evidence. Do not paste secrets or personal data.
